name: les-recettes-de-lionel-et-ophelie
description: A stunning static website to store and showcase cooking recipes

scripts.dev: pnpm run generate:recipes && pnpm run copy:assets && pnpm run build:images && pnpm run build:recipes:dev && vite
scripts.build: pnpm run generate:recipes && pnpm run copy:assets && pnpm run build:images && vite build && pnpm run build:recipes
scripts.copy:assets: shx mkdir -p public/recipes && shx cp recipes.json public/ && shx cp -r recipes/*/ public/recipes/ && shx rm -f public/recipes/index.html
